pages.title: A constant prediction
pages.text:
A constant prediction
If pi = ¯y for every i, its mean is correct but its centered norm is zero.
Correlation is
undeﬁned and nonconstant reference structure is lost.

pages.title: What the mean cannot determine
pages.text:
What the mean cannot determine
A mean constraint controls one component of the ﬁeld error.
Every nonconstant mode can
still be wrong, even when the mean history is exact.
Computational Cardiology Notes 19 / 20

pages.title: A precise synthesis
pages.text:
A precise synthesis
Conservation constrains balances; alignment constrains allowed pose; arrival times
constrain events; ﬁeld norms constrain amplitudes.
The mathematical claim should match
the observable actually established.
Computational Cardiology Notes 20 / 20
